topic: Gaza Strip Israeli Strikes and Casualties

en.headline: Israeli strikes and gunfire kill four people in Gaza
en.body: Israeli strikes and gunfire killed four people in Gaza, according to reports. Medics stated that the fire killed a father and a son, while a third person was killed by gunfire in Khan Younis.

de.headline: Israelische Angriffe und Beschuss fordern vier Tote im Gazastreifen
de.body: Durch israelische Angriffe und Schüsse sind Berichten zufolge vier Menschen im Gazastreifen getötet worden. Sanitäter erklärten, dass durch den Beschuss ein Vater und sein Sohn getötet wurden, während eine dritte Person in Chan Yunis durch Schüsse ums Leben kam.

es.headline: Ataques y disparos israelíes matan a cuatro personas en Gaza
es.body: Los ataques y disparos israelíes mataron a cuatro personas en Gaza, según los informes. Los servicios médicos señalaron que el fuego mató a un padre y a un hijo, mientras que una tercera persona falleció a causa de disparos en Jan Yunis.

it.headline: Attacchi e colpi d'arma da fuoco israeliani uccidono quattro persone a Gaza
it.body: Attacchi e colpi d'arma da fuoco israeliani hanno ucciso quattro persone a Gaza, secondo quanto riferito. I medici hanno dichiarato che il fuoco ha ucciso un padre e un figlio, mentre una terza persona è stata uccisa da colpi d'arma da fuoco a Khan Younis.

pt.headline: Ataques e disparos israelitas matam quatro pessoas em Gaza
pt.body: Ataques e disparos israelitas mataram quatro pessoas em Gaza, segundo relatos. Os serviços médicos afirmaram que os disparos mataram um pai e um filho, enquanto uma terceira pessoa foi morta a tiro em Khan Younis.

zh.headline: 以色列在加沙发动袭击和枪击导致四人死亡
zh.body: 据报道，以色列的袭击和枪击事件在加沙造成四人死亡。医务人员表示，袭击导致一名父亲和他的儿子死亡，另有一人在汗尤尼斯死于枪击。

ja.headline: イスラエルの攻撃と銃撃によりガザで4人が死亡
ja.body: 報道によると、イスラエルの攻撃と銃撃によりガザで4人が死亡した。医療関係者によれば、ハンユニスで父親と息子が砲撃により死亡し、別の1人が銃撃で死亡したという。

ko.headline: 이스라엘의 공습과 총격으로 가자지구에서 4명 사망
ko.body: 보도에 따르면 이스라엘의 공습과 총격으로 가자지구에서 4명이 사망했다. 의료진은 칸유니스에서 아버지와 아들이 포격으로 사망했으며, 세 번째 사람은 총격으로 사망했다고 밝혔다.

fr.headline: Quatre morts dans des frappes et des tirs israéliens à Gaza
fr.body: Quatre personnes ont été tuées par des frappes et des tirs israéliens à Gaza, selon des informations rapportées. Des secouristes ont indiqué qu'un père et son fils ont péri sous les tirs, tandis qu'une troisième personne a été abattue à Khan Younis.

en.title: Israeli strikes and casualties in the Gaza Strip
en.dek: Ongoing Israeli military strikes and gunfire in the Gaza Strip have resulted in multiple fatalities, amid reports of ceasefire violations.

es.title: Ataques y víctimas israelíes en la Franja de Gaza
es.dek: Los continuos ataques militares y disparos de Israel en la Franja de Gaza dejan múltiples víctimas mortales, en medio de informes sobre violaciones del alto el fuego.

fr.title: Bande de Gaza : frappes et victimes israéliennes
fr.dek: Des frappes militaires et des tirs israéliens en cours dans la bande de Gaza font de nombreuses victimes, sur fond d'informations faisant état de violations du cessez-le-feu.

de.title: Israelische Luftangriffe und Opfer im Gazastreifen
de.dek: Anhaltende israelische Militärschläge und Schusswechsel im Gazastreifen fordern zahlreiche Todesopfer, während Berichte über Verstöße gegen die Waffenruhe vorliegen.

pt.title: Ataques e baixas israelitas na Faixa de Gaza
pt.dek: Os ataques militares e disparos israelitas em curso na Faixa de Gaza resultaram em várias vítimas mortais, em meio a relatos de violações do cessar-fogo.

ko.title: 가자 지구 이스라엘 공습 및 사상자 발생
ko.dek: 지속적인 이스라엘 군사 공습과 가자 지구 내 총격전으로 다수의 사망자가 발생했으며, 휴전 위반 보고가 나오고 있다.

ja.title: ガザ地区でのイスラエル軍による攻撃と死傷者
ja.dek: ガザ地区で続くイスラエル軍の空爆と銃撃により多数の死者が出ている。停戦違反の報告もなされている。

it.title: Attacchi israeliani e vittime nella Striscia di Gaza
it.dek: Gli attacchi militari israeliani in corso e i tiri nella Striscia di Gaza provocano multiple vittime, in mezzo a segnalazioni di violazioni del cessate il fuoco.

zh.title: 加沙地带以色列袭击与伤亡
zh.dek: 加沙地带持续的以色列军事袭击和枪声导致多人死亡，同时有报告称违反了停火协议。

en.title: Israeli Strikes and Gunfire Kill Four People in Gaza
en.dek: Recent Israeli military action in the Gaza Strip leaves four people dead, according to medics and news reports.
facts: Four people were killed by Israeli strikes and gunfire in Gaza.
Medics stated that a father and a son were among those killed by the fire.
A third person was killed by gunfire in Khan Younis.
Reports confirmed the casualties resulting from the military operations.
body: Israeli strikes and gunfire resulted in four deaths in the Gaza Strip, according to reports published on 10 November 2026. The operations caused casualties across multiple locations in the territory as military action continued.
Medics stated that the fire killed a father and a son during the incidents. Details regarding the exact circumstances of their deaths were provided by medical personnel responding to the scene.
A third person was killed by gunfire in Khan Younis, according to statements from medics. Khan Younis has been a frequent site of military activity during the ongoing conflict.
The identity of the fourth victim and the precise location of the fourth fatality were included in the overall death toll reported by news outlets.
Medical teams in the Gaza Strip continue to respond to sites affected by Israeli strikes and ground operations. These responders report on casualties as they reach areas impacted by the fire.

The Boston Globe, Arab News, and The Straits Times published accounts of the strikes and gunfire based on information from medics on the ground. Further details regarding the total extent of the damage are expected as reports are verified.
en.context: The Gaza Strip has experienced continuous military conflict involving Israeli forces and local factions. Medical infrastructure in the territory operates under severe strain while responding to casualties from ongoing strikes.
